notes.title: Updated gameplay trailer with epic music
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm super excited to show you the updated gameplay trailer featuring an awesome new track by Omer Faran: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DS7jtN4n6Dk&feature=youtu.be"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Festival report
notes.notes: [p]I'm excited to report that the Debut Festival and the 4X Festival were awesome for building awareness of Vega Chronicle:[/p][list][*][p]We more than doubled our wishlist count over about two weeks[/p][/*][*][p]We received feedback encouraging us to to translate the game into more languages, starting with Simplified Chinese, which we are currently working on.[/p][/*][*][p]We learned about other cool 4X games currently in development (Check out Folk Emerging).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam 4X Fest 2025
notes.notes: [p]I'm thrilled to announce that Vega Chronicle will participate in the Steam 4X Fest 2025, from 8/11 to 8/18, and will run a playtest during the festival with a new game version.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/f4ecc3d1d6538f46a289334f5cc1551610b1ff7d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Debut Festival 2025 on gamedev.ist
notes.notes: [p]I'm excited to announce that Vega Chronicle is participating in [b]Debut Festival 2025 [/b]hosted by [url="https://gamedev.ist/"]gamedev.ist[/url], starting on Thursday and continuing through the weekend. It will be awesome.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/2c14c51e8ee6322552f04495834e054f6a1891b1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: v0.8.6-beta
notes.notes: [p]I'm excited to share version 0.8.6-beta, which incorporates feedback from the public play-test over the last two weeks. It includes:[/p][list][*][p]Pirates! "The only way to stop them for good is to find and destroy their bases" (and get the booty).[/p][/*][*][p]More and better ancestral virtues, such as Cryo-tunneling: "Colonize frozen planets without a colony ship".[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Planet resources degrade if you over-exploit them: diversify your production for long-term sustainability.[/p][/*][/list][p]See the [url="https://justaddlava.com/vegachronicle/changelog.txt"]changelog[/url] for a full list.[/p]

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes: [p]Hello friends![/p][olist][*][p]We've been hard at work making a demo version of Vega Chronicle so that folks can start playing and give us feedback to help shape the game. It's almost ready! [/p][/*][*][p]We overhauled the Steam page: go check out the new descriptions, screenshots and gameplay video :)[/p][/*][*][p]Here's a new gif  <3[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/8258e172e51faf3645179790853f981dda8c36d1.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Victory conditions update
notes.notes: [p]This week we added multiple victory conditions. Choose your path to glory:[/p][olist][*][p]"Development": Build nexuses in 1/3 of the galaxy's star systems.[/p][/*][*][p]"Science": Complete the technology tree and research Existential manipulation.[/p][/*][*][p]"Culture": Construct 5 monuments.[/p][/*][*][p]"Elimination": Destroy all rival civilizations.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Here's a sneak peek at some of the ships you can build in Vega Chronicle:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/dc30031a4181afffaf7ded6c7e592c7d7fdf6c35.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Diplomacy and trade update
notes.notes: [p]Hello friends![/p][olist][*][p]This week we built a diplomacy system where you can trade and negotiate with other space-faring civilizations. We also added more music and sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]We set a goal to start play-testing the demo by the second week of July: we'll be asking for your help![/p][/*][*][p]Here's a sneak-peek at the diplomacy interface:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/c2f94a62d42cb67a7b2248a4d5808c1d8c7c593c.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Audio update and planets sneak peek
notes.notes: [p]We have been working on getting music and sound effects into the game: you'll see game-play with audio soon![/p][p]Here's a sneak peek at some of the of planets you can discover in Vega Chronicle:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/545e2ed06689b71b8aae88db31cc0e420e7d9632.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Wow 4 days since launching the store page [Thank you for helping!]
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/7768a515ff4319adadace50c68c531c0e72b51ae.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello friends![/p][p][/p][p]It feels incredible to have finally launched the Vega Chronicle store page and announcement trailer. Thank you for all that you've done to help: wish-listing, sharing ideas, and spreading the word.[/p][p][/p][p]Since then I have gotten great feedback on the game and I improved the original trailer. Now I'm going to focus back on game development: the next step is to finish a demo build to start closed play-testing later this summer. The medium-term vision is to work with play-testers over the next several months to make an awesome demo that can be shared with streamers and media.[/p][p][/p][p]I will give weekly updates here.[/p]
